messages:
nora: Quick sync — planning a small engine + quant-profile push tonight 23:30 UTC (slice-7). Kernel v2.3.1 + qprofile q1.06. 30m window. Need a deploy owner + smoke buddy. Any volunteers? @kevin @sylvia
kevin: I can take owner. Will run a 3-node canary, then ramp if stable. ETA 23:30 UTC. I'll post status updates here. :thumbsup:
sylvia: I can be smoke buddy. I'll run perf + correctness checks and watch traces. what are the exact smoke commands?
kevin: Smoke/run commands below — will run them in the canary window:
```bash
./deploy --slice slice-7 --image runtime:v2.3.1 --qprofile q1.06 --canary 3
./smoke-check.sh --slice slice-7 --tests smoke,latency,kv
```
I'll also ping eng-oncall and SRE.
jaya: Rollback plan? which image + qprofile do we revert to if needed?
kevin: Rollback tags are runtime:v2.3.0 + qprofile q1.05. I'll keep a pinned manifest at s3://redwood/manifests/slice-7/last-good.json for quick restores.
sam: I'll stand by for infra support. If canary fails persistently, revert within 10m of first failure unless we agree otherwise here.
lee: eng-oncall here — I'll shadow from 23:20 UTC and monitor error-rate/dashboards. Ping me if we need an immediate rollback.
sylvia: I'll start smoke runs at ~23:35 and check latency p95, error-rate, and KV hit-rate. will paste results into thread.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy for slice-7 at 23:30 UTC by kevin. Canary nodes=3. Rollback triggers: error-rate >5% | latency p95 >2x baseline | failed smoke checks.
kevin: Noted rollback triggers. Plan: pause and revert if any trigger fires. Also opened PR #3124 for the tiny config change — @jaya please review if you can quickly.
jaya: On it, reviewing now. If I can't approve by 23:10, @kevin proceed with caution.
sylvia: Quick note — enable KV cache warmup in the rollout config or we'll see cold-start p99 spikes. kevin, can you add --kv-warmup flag?
kevin: Good catch. Adding --kv-warmup to the deploy command. Command updated.
nora: Thanks team. If canary looks good for 10m we'll roll to remaining nodes in slots 7a/7b. Post debrief in #eng-runtime tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
sam: Copy — I'll collect canary logs and attach them here.
kevin: Starting deploy now (23:30 UTC). Will post progress checkpoints: canary -> ramp -> done. First checkpoint at ~23:36.
sylvia: Smoke start 23:35 — running checks now...
sylvia: Smoke result: PASS for smoke tests. latency p95 ~1.2x baseline (within threshold). KV hit-rate stable. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary stable at 23:40. Proceeding to full rollout.
nora: If anything degrades, call rollback immediately. Otherwise great work — thanks all.
kevin: Full rollout done 23:55. No rollback needed. Will file post-rollout notes and attach manifests/logs.
